fillIfEmpty.blurb: Working, counter and reference electrodes: glassy carbon, gold, platinum, graphite, Ag/AgCl, Hg/HgO and calomel, in glass, PTFE and PEEK bodies.
Glassy carbon, gold and platinum disk working electrodes, straight and L-shaped, in PTFE, PCTFE and PEEK bodies, for voltammetry and electrocatalysis.
Platinum sheet, mesh, wire, ring and spiral counter electrodes, graphite rod and plate electrodes, and gold wire rings for electrochemical cells.
Ag/AgCl, Hg/HgO, saturated calomel, mercurous sulfate and non-aqueous Ag/Ag+ reference electrodes in glass, PTFE and PEEK bodies, in several sizes.
Replaceable PTFE and PEEK electrode holders for glassy carbon, platinum, titanium, copper and sheet electrodes, with gold-plated or steel clips.
Ion exchange membranes for electrolyzers, fuel cells and CO2 electrolysis: PFSA proton exchange, anion exchange, cation exchange and bipolar membranes.
PFSA proton exchange membranes N115, N117, N212 and 300 × 300 mm sheets for PEM fuel cells, water electrolyzers and flow batteries.
Anion exchange membranes for AEM water electrolysis, alkaline fuel cells and CO2 electrolysis: Sustainion, PiperION, Fumasep and PVP membranes.
Cation exchange membranes for electrochemical cells, including the PK-reinforced perfluorinated Fumasep FS-9100-PK.
Bipolar membranes that split water into H+ and OH- for in-situ acid and base generation and bipolar membrane electrolysis: Fumasep FBM.
Electrochemical cells and reactors for lab research: H-cells, jacketed and single-chamber cells, flow cells, electrolyzers, fuel cells and battery cells.
H-type dual-chamber electrochemical cells, 30 + 30 mL to 100 + 100 mL and water-jacketed, for membrane-separated HER, OER and CO2RR studies.
Water splitting reactors and electrolyzers for HER and OER research: zero-gap and PEM/AEM electrolyzer hardware, PMMA and PTFE cells, PEM H2 generators.
CO2 reduction flow cells and electrolyzers: zero-gap MEA electrolyzers, gas diffusion flow cells in PTFE, PEEK and acrylic, and in-situ Raman cells.
Photoelectrochemical reactors for solar water splitting: PTFE PEC cells for IPCE, PV-biased PEC cells and photocatalytic panel reactors.
Fuel cell hardware and reactors: 5 cm² PEM fuel cell hardware, microbial fuel cell reactors and stacks, and vanadium flow cell reactors.
Battery test cells: Swagelok-type two-electrode cells and fixtures in PEEK and PTFE, metal-air battery reactors and metal-flow battery reactors.
Porous electrode materials: GDL carbon paper, carbon cloth, graphite felt, nickel foam, nickel fiber felt and copper foam for electrolyzers and fuel cells.
Ionomer dispersions for catalyst inks: PFSA 5 wt% resin solution, Fumion FAA-3-SOLUT-10 and PiperION 5 wt% anion exchange ionomer.
Peristaltic pumps for electrolyte circulation and dosing: compact knob-control pumps, intelligent stepper pumps with RS485 and Wi-Fi touchscreen models.
Lab equipment for electrochemistry: MEA hot presses and hydraulic presses, fuel cell test stations, temperature control units and accessories.
MEA fabrication equipment: a 20-ton MEA hot press (Model 2000) and 20- and 30-ton hydraulic presses for membrane electrode assembly work.
Specialised research equipment: 400 W fuel cell and metal-air battery tester, fuel cell test station, temperature controlling unit and triboelectric setup.
Lab accessories and materials: a 1 L gas sampling bag with PTFE valve, high-purity aluminium and zinc sheets, and manganese dioxide nanoparticles.
